interface.name: polly_appearance_v1
interface.description: This private global is restricted to the compositor-owned Shell connection. Version 1 selects a known decoration theme. Version 2 stages and commits bounded runtime decoration data; neither version exposes window geometry, input injection, filesystem access or arbitrary rendering commands.

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: connection is not the trusted Shell

request.name: prepare

description.summary: validate a runtime decoration snapshot without applying it

request.description: Configuration is an array of native-endian uint32 words: schema 1, flags, scaled metrics, then opaque ARGB colors. The exact field order, bounds and fixed-point scales are specified by appearance-fields.h. Flags encode left controls (1), round controls (2), pinstripes (4), horizontal gradients (8), generic font family (bits 4-5), hover-only glyphs (64), and text alignment (bits 7-8). Name is a bounded identifier. Document is a readable, immutable memfd sealed against writes, growth, shrinkage and further seal changes. Its exact size is 1-32768 bytes. Data is owned and validated by the Shell; the compositor does not parse JSON. Passing an FD avoids the connection's small individual-message limit. Only one staged snapshot is kept per resource. Invalid configuration is rejected through prepared, not a fatal protocol error.

request.name: cancel
request.description: Cancellation is idempotent; it never changes the committed appearance.

interface.name: polly_theme_manager_v1

description.summary: read-only appearance subscription for opt-in applications

interface.description: Public clients may observe the bounded theme document published by the trusted Shell. This interface grants no management or file access. Changes coalesce until the client requests the latest snapshot. Revisions are opaque uint identifiers, not timestamps.

entry.name: unexpected_request
entry.summary: snapshot requested without a change notification

request.name: get_snapshot
request.description: Exactly one request is allowed after changed. The snapshot may be newer than that notification. The unavailable event means that the Shell has not published a runtime theme, or selected legacy decorations.
